reviews.text: Very professional, huge selection, excellent service and advice.

Excellent pet store with a good selection and attractive prices.

Please note that the store is currently undergoing renovations.
Hopefully it will be even better!

The service was absolutely appalling, provided by the saleswoman, the only employee retained after the change of ownership. It's a far cry from the staff we dealt with before; they're no longer wholesalers, and prices have more than doubled for professionals. I will never set foot in your establishment again.

If I could give zero stars, I would. The service was appalling because I had the misfortune of mentioning that it would have been helpful to inform the staff that, following the change of ownership, the wholesale rate no longer exists and only 10% was applied.

I've been a customer of this company since its inception. Today, I requested a goodwill gesture of €12 (excluding VAT) for express order preparation. Their online payment system is inconvenient and no longer allows for the express shipping option they sell. This gesture was denied, and my package will only arrive 5 days after I placed my order. Despite sending an email containing evidence of the errors made at various stages of the order process, from start to finish, my request was refused. Not even a free pack of dog waste bags 🤭
Next time, I'll order from Amazon. They're customer-focused, responsive, and deliver the next day. It's a shame that businesses aren't more customer-friendly towards the professionals they serve. It's regrettable.
I arrived at the store and found it closed. There was a pile of sand and a banner, but nothing had previously informed me of the store's possible closure.
Quality, price!
Great store for our animal friends.

A regular customer for several years, I came this Friday morning, December 5th, to buy a €52 bag of dog food. The service was deplorable; the young woman barely greeted me and made me wait 5 minutes at the register. She didn't apologize at all, quite the opposite... you've lost a customer.
Simple and quick
A very friendly team, good products.
As the owner of a grooming salon since 2006, I work with them. I've noticed that for over six years everything has been deteriorating: products, customer service, deliveries...

Deceptive and unfair business practices. As soon as the store is caught in a mistake (an obvious one), its representatives hide behind alleged insults to avoid fulfilling their obligations to an aggrieved consumer. The DGCCRF (French Directorate General for Competition Policy, Consumer Affairs and Fraud Control) will be notified and a complaint filed. This establishment should be avoided... run away from it... Everything is fine until the day a minor problem forces them to reveal their true colors: merchants who exploit their customers and fail to honor their commitments.
Last order delivered with a soiled item, an open bag of biscuits… no apology or even the slightest offer of compensation… increasingly disappointing…

I placed my order on Thursday, and on Tuesday, having heard nothing, I called. They told me they were still on schedule! Yeah, right. Anyway, the next day they called to tell me that four bottles of shampoo were missing. But they said they'd have them by the end of the week or the beginning of next week. Okay, so I waited for the complete order. Two days later, I received an email with an order ready to ship, but with the four shampoos missing and no explanation. Basically, they said they didn't have them, but they were sending the package anyway. Well, no, they didn't! So I called Distridog. And that's when the trouble started. I got a real gem. I explained the problem and told them I'd have to reorder the shampoos and pay for shipping since I wouldn't qualify for free shipping. They kept going in circles, telling me I had to pay for shipping. No apologies, nothing. Annoyed, I hung up and immediately sent an email to cancel the order and state that I no longer wished to be a customer. Their response: "Due to the insults and abuse, and according to our Terms and Conditions, we are deleting your order and your account." Just so you know, that's exactly what I just asked you to do by email! Anyway.
No apology from them, and to top it all off, a threatening and aggressive email exchange. Bordering on harassment.
When I see the reviews of this so-called professional, frankly, it's frightening.
Avoid them at all costs, whether you're a business or an individual. They have the nerve to promote their terms of sale when they themselves don't apply them. It's laughable.
Before sending a package, you inform the customer if it's okay or not when there are missing items. Furthermore, I acted in bad faith; at no point did I insult or abuse anyone. I am not responsible for your employee's lies. And no, I didn't call him an idiot. There are more than four or five of us who are dissatisfied. Don't dismiss your negative feedback; you should take it into account and change your inappropriate behavior.

Avoid this place! You order four products and pay by credit card on the website. There's no information in the terms and conditions or on the order confirmation specifying the delivery time to the store. When you come to pick up your paid items the next day, you're met with hostility from the reception staff and a completely incompetent office worker who speaks down to you, forgetting basic courtesy and the important point that the customer is the lifeblood of the business, not the other way around. They don't respond to letters sent to management, which shows how they treat you.
AVOID

This company is deplorable. They made a mistake on an order placed on December 22nd, sending a low-quality blouse instead of work trousers. I still haven't received the missing item, and to make matters worse, given that I left a negative review, they won't send me the missing item...

Order error; I've been waiting for my item since December 24th... appalling customer service.

5 stars for Julien, who is very professional.

Thank you to him.
Great for spoiling our pets
I've been going to Distri Dog for years. The staff at the reception desk are very helpful, and you can find absolutely everything you need for pets. It's a bit pricey, but the quality is good.

Seeing the latest reviews, I felt compelled to confirm what was said. I ordered twice, totaling around €250... The order itself was fine, however, they offer a 3% discount for card payments, a discount that only applies after you've validated your cart and gotten to the point of entering your details. I trusted the cart and ended up with €10 in shipping costs because of the 3% discount since I paid by card! I contacted customer service, who told me they had noted on the first invoice that shipping was free, but not on the second one because of a few euros difference... Frankly, I'm disappointed, no understanding, and completely unprofessional! I specifically ordered that amount to avoid shipping costs; otherwise, I wouldn't have placed such a large order!

Furthermore, the stated delivery time of 24 to 72 hours does not include their preparation time, so instead of receiving your order within that timeframe, you will receive it within 7 days. Their customer service is simply appalling! Management is apparently no better. I do not recommend them.

Please be aware, sir, that the "Alex P" account you're replying to me from is NOT MY ACCOUNT. I don't waste my time on this kind of thing, especially with dishonest people like you! I've wasted enough. I came across the "Alex P" account while looking at your reviews. If you were to look at this person's reviews for Sens, Chablis, and other places in France, you'd easily understand that it's not me (since it's a man) and since I'm in the South of France, not in departments 89 and 77, which I don't know. I'm not the type to hide behind a pseudonym. I stand by my actions and words, sir! Stop using your buddy Alex's account to justify yourself. It's pathetic! You really have to be twisted and have time to waste to pull off this kind of Machiavellian manipulation. Use your time to do your job properly and satisfy your customers; it will be more constructive.
